Worn grey-brown robe with wide chocolate crossing lapels, ivory collar, large slate stitched patches on sleeves, faded tan cloth waist belt. Brown travel pack behind viewer-left shoulder with doubled brown shoulder straps. ONE visible hand at viewer right grips a rough plain wooden walking staff vertically, staff top rounded and fully visible.
